entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function responsible for including the Back-off timer value IE under specific congestion or subscription conditions.

entities.name: Back-off timer value
entities.description: IE included by AMF when uplink 5GSM message forwarding fails due to congestion control or subscription issues.

entities.name: Payload container
entities.description: IE containing the uplink 5GSM message that may not be forwarded due to congestion or subscription reasons.

entities.name: Payload container type
entities.description: IE indicating the type of payload container, with value not set to 'Multiple payloads' in this context.

entities.name: Congestion or subscription condition
entities.description: Condition where uplink 5GSM message is not forwarded due to DNN based congestion control, S-NSSAI and DNN based congestion control, S-NSSAI only based congestion control, or DNN not supported/subscribed in a slice.

relations.description: AMF includes the Back-off timer value IE when specific conditions are met.
Payload container IE is associated with conditions where uplink 5GSM message forwarding fails due to congestion or subscription issues.
Payload container type IE not set to 'Multiple payloads' is part of the condition for including Back-off timer value IE.
Congestion or subscription condition establishes the need for including the Back-off timer value IE.
